en.discordDescription: Bind channels to Workspaces and authorize who may use the bot.
en.discordGuildIdHelp: How to get it: enable Developer Mode in Discord (User Settings → Advanced), then right-click the target server and choose "Copy Server ID". One ID per line.
en.discordHintChannelPermissions: The bot lacks permissions in this channel
en.discordHintConfigureToken: Configure the bot token in credentials
en.discordHintEnableIntents: Enable privileged intents in the Developer Portal
en.discordHintTokenRejected: Discord rejected the token — update it
en.discordInvalidIds: IDs must be 17–20 digit snowflakes, one per line
en.discordTokenHelp: From the Discord Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token. Stored in the Host credential service; never written to settings or logs.
en.discordTokenReconnectHint: The token is stored in the Host credential service. Leave empty to reconnect, or paste a new one to replace it.
en.discordTokenSaved: Saved token — leave empty to reconnect
